description: This file provides inline functions for CSR (Control and Status Register) access tailored for a RISC-V architecture with configurable data width, specifically for the Litex VexRiscv SoC. It includes functions for reading and writing 8, 16, 32, and 64-bit values, with support for different CSR data widths, and handles low-level hardware register access.

methods.name: litex_read8
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from a given address, considering CSR data width configuration.

methods.name: litex_read16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit value from a given address, considering CSR data width configuration.

methods.name: litex_read32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from a given address, considering CSR data width configuration.

methods.name: litex_read64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit value from a given address, considering CSR data width configuration.

methods.name: litex_write8
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to a given address, considering CSR data width configuration.

methods.name: litex_write16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a given address, considering CSR data width configuration.

methods.name: litex_write32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a given address, considering CSR data width configuration.

methods.name: litex_write
methods.description: Writes a value of size 1, 2, or 4 bytes to a specified address, aligned to 4 bytes.

methods.name: litex_read
methods.description: Reads a value of size 1, 2, or 4 bytes from a specified address, aligned to 4 bytes.
